reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: Rights Issue of new Ordinary Voting Shares
reqBaseAnnouncement.votingShrsPropToBeIssued: One (01) new Ordinary Voting share for every Eight (08) existing Ordinary Voting shares held by the shareholders in the Register of Shareholders as at end of trading on the Date of Entitlement.
reqBaseAnnouncement.perposeOfTheIssue: The purpose for which the proceeds of the issue are to be utilised to strengthen the Tier 1 capital base of the Company in line with the Company’s expansion and maintain the capital adequacy requirements as stipulated by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.
